title_en: Duo Duo Boss and Forest Grandma
full_text_zh:
[P1] 多多老板和
森林婆婆
藤真知子 文 木场叶子 图 蒲蒲兰 译

[P2] 久久国居民坚信，森林的守护神“森林婆婆”，
就在森林中那棵最大的树上。
森林将无数的果实、蘑菇以及柴火送给了久久国的人们。
一直以来，人们尊重、爱护着森林，
过着幸福的生活。

[P3] 久久国海的另一边，有一个多多国。
多多国居民从不放过任何一个赚钱的机会。
饭店老板多多常常想。
“久久国的森林，就那样荒废着，真是太浪费了。
还是砍伐森林，经营牧场吧。养上牛，再用便宜的肉，
做成美味的汉堡，赚到更多的钱，变成大大大富翁！”

[P4] “砍伐森林，经营牧场！想要什么，就有什么！”
来到久久国的多多老板大力鼓吹。

[P5] “砍伐森林，经营牧场！想要什么，就有什么！”
来到久久国的多多老板大力鼓吹。

[P6] “牧场里养上牛，卖了牛，
换成钱！有了钱，就能买到
所有想要的东西！”
多多老板炫耀着带过来的电视、
汽车和漂亮的衣服。

“不行！不可以！如果
森林消失，地球会灭亡……”

“有了钱，就算没有森林，
也能买到吃的喽。”

“多亏森林的庇护我们才能
生存下来！没有它给的果实、
蘑菇和柴火，我们可活不下去！”

“我想要漂亮的衣服！”
“好棒的车啊！”

[P7] 年老的居民畏惧森林婆婆，反对砍伐森林。
年轻的居民听从多多老板，开始砍伐森林。
但是，他们畏惧的森林婆婆并没有出现。
“什么嘛，根本就没有什么森林婆婆！”
一开始反对的人们也开始砍伐森林、经营牧场，
牛的数量越来越多。

[P8] 久久国的居民用卖牛赚到的钱，买了新房子、新车子。
他们渴望越来越多的，可以用钱买到的东西。
为此卖了更多的牛，买到了更多喜欢的东西。
最后，剩下的只有那棵，
据说有森林婆婆居住的大树而已。

[P9] 汉堡北&饭店北大王
多多老板
“你们看！还是钱好！只要有钱，
就能过上好日子！”有了便宜的牛肉，
多多老板的生意更加兴隆。
味美价廉的汉堡包卖得飞快，多多老板的
连锁店越来越多，他也成了超级大富翁！

[P10] 有一天。
久久国下起了瓢泼大雨。
日复一日，大雨下个不停……

[P11] 不久，洪水爆发了！

洪水过后，干旱又持续了很长时间，大地干裂了。

牧场里不再有鲜嫩青草，田里的农作物也都枯萎了。

[P12] “怎么会变成这样？”
“我们毁坏了森林，惹森林婆婆生气了！”
“我们就不该听多多的话！”
“地球要灭亡了！”
久久国居民吓得瑟瑟发抖。

[P13] “一群笨蛋！没有森林，地球也不会灭亡！哪有什么森林婆婆！”多多老板冲进久久国。
“我证明给你们看！”向仅存的、森林婆婆居住的大树……
挥起斧头。
就在这时！

[P14] “森林婆婆！”
久久国居民齐声高呼。
出现的就是森林的守护神——
“森林婆婆”。
“所有灾难都是你们砍伐森林引起的！
这样下去，世界将变得一团糟。”

[P15] “洪水的爆发、持续的干旱，
是因为没有了森林。森林能够储存雨水，
使它流向河床，避免洪水的发生。
森林还能把雨水还给天空，
再度降下雨滴。”

“雨后森林的土壤中会滋生出无数的
肉眼无法看到的小小的生物。
它们能滋养肥沃的土地，培育青草与树木。”

[P16] “森林还能净化空气。”

“然而，你们却一而再、再而三地破坏森林直至它消失，
贪图便利的生活，污染了空气。
如果继续下去，将会发生更可怕的事！”

[P17] 听完森林婆婆的话，
可怕的景象立即浮现在人们的眼前。
无论是多多国的高楼大厦，还是久久国的新房子，
全都被海水所淹没。
“被污染的空气使得地球越来越热。
寒冷国度的冰雪将融化，整个世界都会沉到水底！
这样你们也无所谓吗？”

[P18] 听完森林婆婆的话，
可怕的景象立即浮现在人们的眼前。
无论是多多国的高楼大厦，还是久久国的新房子，
全都被海水所淹没。
“被污染的空气使得地球越来越热。
寒冷国度的冰雪将融化，整个世界都会沉到水底！
这样你们也无所谓吗？”

[P19] “啊！是我错了！多亏了森林，
我们才能够活下来！可我们却毁掉了森林。
森林婆婆告诉我们，怎样才能阻止未来变得那么可怕？”
多多老板大声请求。
“挽救方法只有一个——用你们对未来世界和人类的爱！”
没等人们回过神，森林婆婆早已消失了踪影，
但声音却在人们的耳畔回响。

[P20] “是啊！我们不能让未来变得那么可怕！
我们要送给未来的人一个美丽的地球！”
多多老板说。
久久国居民也举双手赞成。

[P21] “如果森林消失，地球就会灭亡。”
久久国流传下来的古老预言，千真万确。

为了将一个美丽、充满生机的地球，
当作礼物送给未来的人们，你能做些什么呢？

[P22] “如果森林消失，地球就会灭亡。”
久久国流传下来的古老预言，千真万确。

为了将一个美丽、充满生机的地球，
当作礼物送给未来的人们，你能做些什么呢？
full_text_en:
[P1] Duo Duo Boss and
Forest Grandma
Fuji Tomoko, text; Kiba Yoshiko, illustrations; Pu Pu Lan, translator

[P2] The people of Jiujiu Country firmly believe that the forest's guardian spirit, 'Grandma Forest,'
resides in the largest tree in the forest.
The forest gives countless fruits, mushrooms, and firewood to the people of Jiujiu Country.
All along, people have respected and cared for the forest,
living happy lives.

[P3] On the other side of the sea from Jiujiu Kingdom, there is a place called Duoduo Kingdom.
The people of Duoduo Kingdom never miss any opportunity to make money.
The restaurant owner, Duoduo, often thinks:
"The forest in Jiujiu Kingdom is just lying there, wasted.
I should cut down the forest and start a ranch. Raise cows, use cheap meat,
make delicious hamburgers, earn even more money, and become a super, super rich man!"

[P4] "Cut down the forest, run a ranch! Want anything, and you'll have it!"
Duo Duo, the boss from Duoduo Country, passionately promotes his idea upon arriving in Jiujiu Country.

[P5] "Cut down the forest, run a ranch! Want anything, and you'll have it!"
Mr. Dodo, arriving in the land of Jiujiu, passionately promotes his idea.

[P6] "In the pasture, we raise cows, sell them, turn them into money! With money, we can buy everything we want!"
Boss Dodo proudly shows off the TV, car, and beautiful clothes he brought.

"No! Not allowed! If the forest disappears, the Earth will die..."

"With money, even without a forest, we can buy food!"

"Thanks to the forest's protection, we can survive! Without its fruits, mushrooms, and firewood, we couldn't live!"

"I want beautiful clothes!"
"What a great car!"

[P7] The elderly residents feared Forest Grandma and opposed cutting down the forest.
The younger residents followed Boss Dodo and began cutting down the forest.
But the forest grandma they feared did not appear.
"What nonsense, there's no such thing as Forest Grandma!"
Those who had initially opposed it also began cutting down the forest and running ranches,
and the number of cows kept increasing.

[P8] The residents of Jiujiu Kingdom used the money earned from selling cows to buy new houses and new cars.
They longed for more and more things that could be bought with money.
To do so, they sold even more cows and bought more things they liked.
In the end, the only thing left was that tree,
the one said to be home to the Forest Grandma.

[P9] Hamburger King & Restaurant King
Duo Duo Boss
"Look! Money is the best! As long as you have money,
 you can live a good life!" With cheap beef,
 Duo Duo Boss's business became even more prosperous.
 Delicious and affordable hamburgers sold like hotcakes, Duo Duo Boss's
 chain stores grew more and more, and he became a super rich tycoon!

[P10] One day.
A heavy downpour began in Jiujiu Kingdom.
Day after day, the rain kept falling...

[P11] Soon, the flood broke out!

After the flood, drought lasted for a long time, and the earth cracked.

There was no more fresh grass in the pasture, and the crops in the fields withered too.

[P12] "How could it become like this?"
"We destroyed the forest and made the Forest Grandma angry!"
"We shouldn't have listened to Dodo!"
"The Earth is going to die!"
Residents of Jiujiu Kingdom trembled with fear.

[P13] "A bunch of fools! Without forests, the Earth won't perish! There's no such thing as Grandma Forest!" Mr. Duo Duo rushed into the land of Jiujiu.
"I'll prove it to you!" Toward the last remaining tree, where Grandma Forest lived...
He raised his axe.
Just then!

[P14] "Forest Grandma!"
Residents of Jiujiu Kingdom shouted in unison.
The one who appeared was the guardian spirit of the forest—
"Forest Grandma".
"All these disasters are caused by your deforestation!
If you keep going like this, the world will become a mess."

[P15] "The sudden floods and prolonged droughts
are because there are no forests. Forests can store rainwater,
channeling it into riverbeds to prevent floods.
Forests can also return rainwater to the sky,
causing rain to fall once more."

"After rain, countless tiny organisms,
invisible to the naked eye,
emerge in the forest soil.
They nourish fertile land and cultivate grass and trees."

[P16] "Forests can also purify the air."

"Yet, you keep destroying the forests again and again until they disappear,
seeking convenient lives and polluting the air.
If you continue, something even more terrible will happen!"

[P17] After hearing the Forest Grandma's words,
the terrifying scene immediately appeared before people's eyes.
Whether it's the skyscrapers of Duoduo Kingdom or the new houses of Jiujiu Kingdom,
they were all submerged by seawater.
"Polluted air is making the Earth hotter and hotter.
The ice and snow in cold countries will melt, and the entire world will sink to the bottom of the sea!
Do you really not care about this?"

[P18] After hearing the Forest Grandma's words,
the terrifying scene immediately appeared before people's eyes.
Whether it was the skyscrapers of Duoduo Country or the new houses of Jiujiu Country,
they were all submerged by seawater.
"Polluted air is making the Earth hotter and hotter.
The ice and snow in cold countries will melt, and the entire world will sink to the bottom of the sea!
Are you really indifferent to this?"

[P19] "Ah! I was wrong! Thanks to the forest,
we were able to survive! But we destroyed the forest.
Grandmother Forest, tell us, how can we stop the future from becoming so terrible?"
Mr. Duo Duo pleaded loudly.
"The only way to save it is—use your love for the future world and for humanity!"
Before people could recover, Grandmother Forest had already vanished,
but her voice echoed in their ears.

[P20] "Yes! We can't let the future become so terrible!
We must give the people of the future a beautiful Earth!"
Mr. Duo Duo said.
The residents of Jiujiu Country also raised both hands in agreement.

[P21] "If forests disappear, the Earth will perish."
An ancient prophecy passed down in Jiujiu Kingdom, absolutely true.

To give a beautiful, vibrant Earth,
as a gift to future generations, what can you do?

[P22] "If forests disappear, the Earth will perish."
An ancient prophecy passed down in Jiujiu Kingdom, absolutely true.

To give a beautiful, vibrant Earth,
as a gift to future generations, what can you do?
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《多多老板和森林婆婆》，作者为藤真知子，插图为木场叶子，译者为蒲蒲兰。画面中央是一位穿着红色衣服、手持小植物的光头老板形象，背景为绿色森林。
[P2] 本页描绘了久久国居民与森林和谐共处的景象，文字说明森林婆婆守护着森林，并为人们提供果实、蘑菇和柴火，人们因此尊重森林并过着幸福的生活。
[P3] 本页介绍了多多国及其居民热衷赚钱的特点，饭店老板多多正在思考如何利用久久国的森林资源来牟利，计划砍伐森林、经营牧场并制作汉堡以赚取更多财富。
[P4] 多多老板驾驶黄色汽车来到久久国，高声鼓吹砍伐森林、经营牧场以获取财富，而久久国的居民们则面露惊讶和担忧地看着他。
[P5] 多多老板驾驶黄色汽车来到久久国，高声鼓吹砍伐森林、经营牧场以获取财富，而久久国的居民们则面露惊讶和担忧地看着他。
[P6] 多多老板向久久国居民展示金钱带来的物质享受，而居民们则表达了对森林的依赖和对砍伐森林的担忧，同时也有孩子被物质诱惑，表现出对新事物的向往。
[P7] 本页描绘了久久国居民在多多老板的影响下，逐渐放弃对森林婆婆的敬畏，开始砍伐森林并经营牧场，牛群数量不断增加，森林被大规模破坏。
[P8] 久久国居民因追求金钱和物质享受，不断砍伐森林、出售牛群，最终只剩下森林婆婆居住的那棵大树。
[P9] 本页展示了多多老板凭借便宜牛肉和汉堡生意迅速致富，连锁店遍布各地，他成为超级大富翁，画面中人们享受着汉堡带来的物质满足。
[P10] 久久国下起了连绵不断的瓢泼大雨，居民们撑着伞在雨中行走，画面展现了持续降雨带来的阴沉景象。
[P11] 洪水过后，久久国遭遇长期干旱，大地干裂，牧场无草，农田枯萎，生态环境严重恶化。
[P12] 久久国居民因破坏森林导致环境恶化，面对灾难性后果，他们惊恐万分，意识到错误并后悔听从多多老板的建议。
[P13] 多多老板冲进久久国，嘲笑森林婆婆的存在，扬言要证明没有森林地球也不会灭亡，并挥斧砍向仅存的森林婆婆居住的大树，就在他动手的瞬间，画面转为全黑，预示着即将发生的重大转折。
[P14] 在多多老板砍伐最后一棵大树的瞬间，森林的守护神‘森林婆婆’现身，指责居民们砍伐森林导致灾难，并警告若继续下去世界将陷入混乱。
[P15] 森林婆婆解释森林对水循环和土壤生态的重要性，说明森林能储存雨水、防止洪水，并通过滋养土壤促进植物生长。
[P16] 森林婆婆继续解释森林净化空气的作用，而画面对比了森林与城市污染的景象，强调人类破坏森林导致空气污染的后果。
[P17] 森林婆婆向居民们描述了因破坏环境导致的可怕后果：城市被海水淹没，全球变暖使冰雪融化，世界面临沉入水底的危机，居民们震惊不已。
[P18] 森林婆婆描述了因环境破坏导致的灾难性后果：城市被海水淹没，全球变暖使冰雪融化，世界面临沉入水底的危机，居民们震惊不已。
[P19] 多多老板和居民们悔悟自己破坏森林的错误，向森林婆婆求助如何阻止灾难，森林婆婆留下关键的拯救方法后消失，她的声音在人们耳边回响。
[P20] 多多老板和久久国居民们决心保护地球，承诺为未来的人留下一个美丽的家园，大家手拉手团结一致。
[P21] 页面引用了久久国的古老预言，强调森林消失将导致地球灭亡，并以森林婆婆浇灌幼苗的画面，呼吁读者思考如何为未来的人类保护地球。
[P22] 页面引用久久国的古老预言，强调森林消失将导致地球灭亡，并以森林婆婆浇灌幼苗的画面，呼吁读者思考如何为未来的人类保护地球。
